Bösendorfer The Great Wave off Kanagawa Grand Piano (Collector's Item)
art.description: A stunning collector’s edition grand piano paying homage to Hokusai’s iconic 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa.' Limited to just 16 individually numbered instruments worldwide, this masterpiece features the renowned artwork specially printed on the underside of the lid, with rich Prussian blue and vibrant red color accents inspired by Japanese culture. Crafted in Austria using Bösendorfer’s signature resonance case principle, open pinblock, and hand-spun bass strings, the piano blends cutting-edge Viennese piano engineering with art and symbolism. The 214VC size is prized for its dynamic range, tonal clarity, and singing resonance. This unique collaboration between Japanese art and Austrian craftsmanship is both a musical instrument and a museum-worthy work of art.

art.name: Illuminated manuscript HORAE – A Wildly Eccentric and Personal Book of Hours
art.author: Unknown (Paris/Rouen Masters, attributed c. 1490)
art.model: Book of Hours, Use of Amiens
art.description: An exceedingly rare, fully illuminated Book of Hours (HORAE) created in Amiens around 1490, featuring 24 small calendar miniatures, 4 smaller miniatures, and 17 full-page miniatures amid burlesque borders. Each page is meticulously illuminated, populated with grotesques, dragons, dwarfs, musicians, satyrs, mermaids, chimeras, and scenes evoking both secular and spiritual life of the Netherlands during the Dukes of Burgundy. Distinguished for its eccentric artistry and vibrant evocation of 15th-century life, this collectible stands as a museum-worthy artifact and a masterpiece of late medieval illumination.

art.name: Book of Hours (Use of Paris, Illuminated Manuscript)
art.author: Master of the Bible Historiale fr. 159 (attributed)
art.model: Book of Hours, Use of Paris
art.provenance: Commissioned by a female patron, several French noble families, Jean-Baptiste Titon de Villotran, Les Enluminures / Bruce Ferrini, Private Collection
art.description: A beautifully executed and unusual Parisian Book of Hours illuminated around 1400–1410. Painted at the time of the Duke of Berry, with 15 large miniatures attributed to the Master of the Bible Historiale fr. 159. Contains 224 folios, richly decorated with burnished gold, pink, and blue initials, elaborate borders with ivyleaf infill, and highly detailed miniatures. Originally commissioned for a French noblewoman, its provenance passes through several prominent French families and antiquarian collections. This museum-worthy artifact exemplifies Parisian manuscript art, its liturgical use and exquisite condition reflecting a special moment in Northern art history.

art.name: Life-size 1871 photograph of the Fra Mauro map of the world
art.author: Carlo Naya (photographer); Fra Mauro (cartographer, original map)
art.provenance: Venice, Carlo Naya studio; Antiquariat Inlibris Gilhofer Nfg. GmbH, Vienna
art.description: A life-sized, hand-coloured photograph of the celebrated Fra Mauro mappamundi, originally drawn around 1450 and widely hailed as the greatest achievement in medieval cartography. Created ca. 1871 by Italian photographer Carlo Naya in Venice, this monumental print (223 x 223 cm) reproduces the world map in full scale, capturing its hundreds of illustrations and thousands of descriptive texts. Naya’s photograph marked a pioneering moment in art history and large-format photography. Fra Mauro’s map, oriented with south at the top, represents both a scientific masterpiece and a bridge between medieval and Renaissance worldviews. Only a handful of these photographs are known to exist in major libraries and museums.

art.name: Rudimentary treatise on the power of water, as applied to drive flour mills, and to give motion to turbines and other hydrostatic engines
art.author: Joseph Glynn
art.provenance: S N Books World, Delhi, India
art.description: A leather-bound reprint of 'Rudimentary treatise on the power of water, as applied to drive flour mills, and to give motion to turbines and other hydrostatic engines' by Joseph Glynn. Originally published in 1853, this edition is reprinted in 2025 with original text and illustrations, and includes an appendix on centrifugal and rotary pumps. The binding features gilt printing on the spine and satin ribbon page markers. An excellent addition for collectors interested in early engineering and hydrostatics.

art.name: The Influence of the Blue Ray of the Sunlight and of the Blue Colour of the Sky
art.author: Ge. A. J. [Augustus] Pleasonton
art.medium: Hardcover (blue cloth, gold lettered, blue pages)
art.condition: Very Good (small tear to cloth at head of spine, corners lightly bumped, else near fine)
art.provenance: Apport Used Books, Emmaus, PA, USA
art.description: A scarce second edition of one of the first works on American light therapy, known for inciting a late 19th-century 'blue glass craze.' Written by Civil War general Augustus Pleasonton, the book explores blue and sun-lights' influence upon life and disease, and is celebrated for its blue pages and blue cloth binding stamped with gold. An influential and unusual medical collectible.

art.name: The Works of Aristotle. (First English Edition, Complete Set, Signed by Thomas Taylor)
art.author: Aristotle; Translated by Thomas Taylor
art.medium: Hardcover (Full contemporary calf, gilt titles, morocco spine labels, marbled endpapers)
art.condition: Near fine (only light toning; signed in volumes 1 and 4 by the translator Thomas Taylor; complete in 11 volumes)
art.provenance: Raptis Rare Books, Palm Beach, FL, USA
art.description: Exceptionally rare, complete set of the first edition in English of Aristotle's works, limited to just 50 copies, signed by translator Thomas Taylor in volumes one and four. Eleven quarto volumes (1806–1812), including The Organon, Rhetoric, Ethics, Physics, treatises on Animals, the Metaphysics, and Taylor’s Dissertation on Aristotle. Each bound in full contemporary calf with gilt titles, ribbon bookmarks, and marbled edges and endpapers. These translations marked the first comprehensive system of Western philosophy available in English. A landmark in ancient philosophy and an extraordinary collector’s piece.
